Title: Now Available: Azure Monitor Query client module for Go

Body.Content:
We’re announcing the initial stable release of the Azure Monitor Query client module for Go.

This new, idiomatic module joins the Azure Monitor Query SDK, which is comprised of client libraries for .NET, Java, JavaScript, and Python. The module allows developers to build apps that execute read-only queries in Azure Monitor's Logs and Metrics platforms. Apps can then analyze and display logs and metrics data in custom ways.

Read the announcement blog post for more details and to get started.
